podcast.body: Recorded around 2001, this album marked a significant shift in Oasis's creative process, as Noel Gallagher did not compose all the material for the first time. Material from Liam Gallagher began to appear on the album, indicating a change in the band's songwriting distribution and a perceived decline in Noel's interest in composing solely for the band. "no el Galagher por primera vez no componen todo el material de oasis empieza a ver material de Liam Galagher."

podcast.body: Released in 2002, this album was supported by a tour during which a notable bar brawl involving Liam Gallagher occurred in Munich, Germany, on December 1, 2002. "Oasis was on tour in support of their Heathen chemistry album."
